landing.featuresSubtitle: All the tools you need to version, share, and improve recipes.
landing.featureForkDesc: Create your own version of someone else's recipe and adapt it to your taste.
landing.featureBranchDesc: Experiment on separate branches without changing the original. Perfect for vegan or gluten-free variants.
landing.featureCommitDesc: Every adjustment is saved as a commit — trace your cooking history without gaps.
landing.featureMergeDesc: Offer your improvements to the original author. Together we cook better.
landing.step1Desc: Create your first recipe — like a new repository on GitHub.
landing.step2Desc: Use the visual editor to add ingredients and write preparation steps.
landing.step3Desc: Save your adjustments with a commit message — e.g., 'Reduced sugar'.
landing.step4Desc: Share your recipe publicly or invite others to contribute via GourMerge Requests.

fork.description: Create your own independent copy of someone else's recipe to adapt freely.
fork.helpHint: Forking creates a personal copy of a recipe. Your changes stay separate from the original unless you submit a GourMerge Request.

branch.description: A parallel version of your recipe — experiment without changing the main version.
branch.helpHint: Think of a branch as a 'vegan variant' or 'gluten-free version'. Changes on a branch don't affect other branches until you merge.

commit.description: A named snapshot of your recipe at a specific point in time.
commit.helpHint: Every commit saves all ingredients and steps as a snapshot. You can always go back and see exactly what changed.

merge.description: Apply changes from one variant into another, combining the best of both.
merge.helpHint: When you merge, GourMerge combines the ingredient and step changes. If two people changed the same ingredient differently, you'll see a conflict to resolve.

gourmergeRequest.description: Propose your improvements to the original recipe author for review and merging.
gourmergeRequest.helpHint: A GourMerge Request lets you share your recipe improvements with the original author. They can review your changes, leave comments, and merge them into the original.

diff.description: A side-by-side view of exactly what changed between two versions of a recipe.
diff.helpHint: The diff shows added ingredients in green, removed ones in red, and modified ones highlighted. For step text, individual word changes are highlighted.

history.description: A timeline of all saved versions of this recipe, oldest to newest.
history.helpHint: Every time you commit changes, a new entry appears here. Click any commit to see the full recipe at that point in time, or compare it to another version.
